messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Political behaviour and attitudes and Elections in Saarland during the 2010s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS GLES Saarland Landtagswahl 2017 dataset election survey
Saarland Landtagswahl 2012 2017 Wahlergebnisse open data dataset
Saarland 2017 election study voter attitudes dataset GESIS
action.query: GESIS GLES Saarland Landtagswahl 2017 dataset election survey

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Landtagswahl im Saarland 2012 (State Election in Saarland 2012) — GESIS ZA5642","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13078","justification":"Directly relevant dataset examining the 2012 Saarland state parliamentary election. Part of the GESIS collection of German state election studies, which primarily consists of representative electoral surveys. Useful for investigating voting intentions, party preferences, political attitudes, electoral behaviour, and factors influencing voting decisions in Saarland. Particularly valuable for studying political behaviour during the early 2010s."},{"title":"Landtagswahl im Saarland 2017 (State Election in Saarland 2017) — GESIS ZA6948","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13073","justification":"Directly relevant dataset covering the 2017 Saarland state parliamentary election. Archived by GESIS as part of its German state election studies. Suitable for studying electoral preferences, political attitudes, party evaluations, and voting behaviour surrounding the 2017 election. Especially useful for comparing political behaviour and electoral developments between the 2012 and 2017 Saarland elections."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES): Pre- and Post-Election Cross-Section 2013 — GESIS ZA5702","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/gles/data-and-documentation","justification":"National election survey dataset covering political attitudes and electoral behaviour surrounding the 2013 German federal election. Includes information on voting decisions, political preferences, and attitudes toward political parties and candidates. Potentially useful for analysing Saarland respondents within the broader German electorate, subject to the availability of suitable regional identifiers and sufficient Saarland observations."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES): Pre- and Post-Election Cross-Section 2017 — GESIS ZA6802","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/gles/data-and-documentation","justification":"Survey dataset examining political attitudes and voting behaviour before and after the 2017 German federal election. Provides information on electoral choices, political orientations, party preferences, and candidate evaluations. Relevant for investigating political behaviour among Saarland residents during the same year as the 2017 Saarland state election. Regional analysis depends on access to appropriate geographic identifiers."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES): Rolling Cross-Section 2013 — GESIS ZA5703","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/gles/data-and-documentation","justification":"Election campaign survey conducted around the 2013 German federal election. Provides data for studying changes in voting intentions, political attitudes, and party preferences during an election campaign. Potentially useful for examining Saarland voters in the context of national political developments, provided respondents can be geographically identified."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES): Rolling Cross-Section 2017 — GESIS ZA6803","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/gles/data-and-documentation","justification":"Survey covering the 2017 German federal election campaign, with information about political preferences, electoral intentions, and political attitudes. Particularly relevant for studying political behaviour in Saarland during 2017 and comparing regional political trends with national electoral dynamics. Saarland-specific analysis requires suitable geographic variables and adequate sample sizes."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES): Rolling Cross-Section Cumulation 2009–2017 — GESIS ZA6834","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/gles/data-and-documentation","justification":"Cumulative election survey dataset covering multiple German federal election campaigns between 2009 and 2017. Useful for longitudinal comparisons of political attitudes, electoral preferences, and voting intentions throughout much of the 2010s. Potentially valuable for examining changes among Saarland respondents across election cycles, subject to regional data availability."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES): Sensitive Regional Data — GESIS ZA6828","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/gles/data-and-documentation","justification":"Special GLES data release containing sensitive regional information for election studies conducted between 2013 and 2021. Particularly relevant for researchers seeking to identify respondents geographically and examine political attitudes and electoral behaviour in Saarland. Regional data access may be restricted, and availability of geographic identifiers does not guarantee representative Saarland-specific estimates."},{"title":"Politbarometer: German Political Opinion Surveys, 2010–2019 — GESIS","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/elections/politbarometer","justification":"Collection of approximately monthly representative surveys examining political attitudes among German voters. Covers party preferences, voting intentions, evaluations of politicians, political issues, and public opinion. Annual cumulative datasets and time-series data make the collection useful for studying political changes throughout the 2010s. Relevant to Saarland when regional identifiers or Saarland-specific survey observations are available."},{"title":"German State Election Studies (Landtagswahlen) — GESIS Research Data Collection","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/elections/german-state-elections","justification":"Official GESIS dataset catalogue containing survey studies of elections to German state parliaments. Explicitly lists the Saarland elections of 2012 (ZA5642) and 2017 (ZA6948), with links to their dataset records. Particularly useful for discovering and comparing Saarland-specific electoral surveys, researching political behaviour and attitudes, and accessing accompanying study documentation."}]}
